rꜣ: rꜣ — mouth; utterance, spell (rꜣ n … "spell for …", the heading of a chapter)
ny: ny — of (the genitive adjective; written n, fem. nt, pl. nw): rꜣ n ꜥq "spell of entering"
r: r — to, towards, into, at (preposition); with an infinitive "in order to"; with the sḏmt·f "until"; after an imperative, with a suffix (ir·k), "yourself, then"
wsḫt: wsḫt — broad hall, court; wsḫt mꜣꜥti "the Hall of the Two Truths" (noun)
dwꜣ: dwꜣ — to adore, praise, worship (a god)
wsir: wsir — Osiris, god of the dead and king of the world below; Wsir N "the Osiris N", the dead person (Budge: Ausar)
ḫnty: ḫnty — foremost, who is at the head of (ḫnty imntt "Foremost of the West", a title of Osiris)
ḏd: ḏd — to say, speak; ḏd in N "said by N", the formula that brings in a speech (verb)
in: in — by (naming the agent, as in ḏd in N "said by N"); (particle) it is …
sš: sš — scribe (sš, the palette-and-pen sign); also (verb, here doubtful) to pass, go through
ꜣny: ꜣny — Ani, royal scribe of Thebes, for whom the papyrus was made (personal name)
mꜣꜥ-ḫrw: mꜣꜥ-ḫrw — true of voice, vindicated (said of the dead whose words were found true at the judgement)
sḏm·n·f: sḏm·n·f — the n of the sḏm·n·f form, marking a completed action ("I have …", "I …ed"); written between the verb and its suffix
nfrw: nfrw — beauty, goodness (abstract plural of nfr "good, beautiful")
·k: ·k — you, your (2nd person masculine singular suffix pronoun; the basket sign)
ꜥ: ꜥ — arm, hand (dual ꜥwy "the two arms")
ḫpr: ḫpr — to come into being, happen, become (verb)
ꜥš: ꜥš — cedar, or another conifer (its wood)
msi: msi — to give birth; (passive) to be born
sḏmt·f: sḏmt·f — the t of the sḏmt·f form: after n "has not yet …"; after r "until …" (verb form)
qmꜣ: qmꜣ — to create, produce, bring forth (verb)
štꜣ: štꜣ — secret, hidden; štꜣw "secret things, mysteries" (adjective)
iw: iw — particle that opens a statement, often with a suffix (iw·f "he …"); not translated
stẖ: stẖ — Seth, god of storm and disorder, who murdered Osiris (written stẖ or swt; Budge: Sut)
ḫnm: ḫnm — to smell; to be joined with; (here, doubtfully) companion, friend
tkn: tkn — to approach, draw near (tkn m "come near to")
ḥr: ḥr — face; (preposition) upon, on, over, concerning
·f: ·f — he, him, his, it (3rd person masculine singular suffix pronoun; the horned viper)
nty: nty — who, which, that (relative adjective); as a noun "he who"
ḏꜣḏꜣt: ḏꜣḏꜣt — council, tribunal (of gods or magistrates)
sbḫt: sbḫt — gateway, portal (of a temple or of the world below)
ꜣḫ: ꜣḫ — spirit, the glorified and effective dead (the crested ibis)
inpw: inpw — Anubis, the jackal god of the cemetery and of embalming (Budge: Anpu)
iwi: iwi — to come (participle iw "coming, who comes")
·n: ·n — we, us, our (1st person plural suffix pronoun; water sign with plural strokes)
ḥtp: ḥtp — to be content, at peace, to rest; peace (m ḥtp "in peace"); offering
·kwi: ·kwi — 1st person singular ending of the stative ("I am …, I have …")
snsn: snsn — to smell, breathe (reduplicated from sn "smell, kiss")
wꜥ: wꜥ — one; (as a noun) one (of), someone
·tn: ·tn — you, your (2nd person plural suffix pronoun)
ink: ink — I (1st person singular independent pronoun; ink N "I am N")
imy: imy — who/which is in (the nisba of m "in"; plural imyw)
kꜣ: kꜣ — ka, the life-force that receives offerings; (plural kꜣw, perhaps) food, sustenance
·sn: ·sn — they, them, their (3rd person plural suffix pronoun)
wnn: wnn — to be, exist (wn·n·i "I have been"; n wn "there is not")
bꜣ: bꜣ — ba, soul; the Ram (the ba-ram of Mendes)
nb: nb — lord, master, possessor (of); (adjective, after a noun) every, all
ḏdt: ḏdt — Mendes in the Delta (Djedet), city of the Ram (Budge: Tattu)
rdi: rdi — to give, put, place; with a sḏm·f, to cause, let (di·f pr·i "he let me come forth")
pri: pri — to go out, come forth (verb)
bnw: bnw — the Bennu, the sun's heron of Heliopolis (the Greek phoenix)
sm: sm — to go, make one's way (?) — a doubtful reading
ꜣbḏw: ꜣbḏw — Abydos, the holy city of Osiris (Budge: Abtu)
pr-sṯt: pr-sṯt — "the House of Satet", a shrine (reading uncertain; Budge: Per-Satet)
smḥ: smḥ — to sink, submerge (causative of mḥ "be drowned")
wiꜣ: wiꜣ — boat, bark (especially of a god)
nšmt: nšmt — the Neshmet, the sacred bark of Osiris at Abydos (Budge: neshem boat)
km-wr: km-wr — "the Great Black", a sacred place with a bull-cult (Budge: Qem-ur)
sgr: sgr — to silence, make quiet (causative of gr "be silent")
sḫm: sḫm — power, might; sacred image, cult statue (noun)
rd: rd — foot, leg (dual rd·fy "his two feet")
pr-tp-ḏw-f: pr-tp-ḏw-f — "the House of Him who is upon his Mountain", the house of Anubis (Budge: Per-tep-tu-f)
pr-wsir: pr-wsir — "the House of Osiris"; also the Egyptian name of Busiris (Budge: Per-Ausar)
kfꜣ: kfꜣ — to uncover, strip (cf. kf) — or, here, to wrap oneself (sense uncertain)
ꜥfnt: ꜥfnt — head-cloth, the bag-shaped head-covering (plural ꜥfnwt)
im: im — there, therein (adverb; nty im "he who is there")
imn: imn — to hide, conceal; to be hidden (verb)
tš: tš — boundary, district; (here, with walking legs, doubtful) a way through, passage
n-iꜣrrd-f: n-iꜣrrd-f — An-arutef ("It does not grow"?), a holy place of Osiris (reading uncertain; Budge: An-aarut-f)
rḫyt: rḫyt — common folk, subjects (written with the lapwing)
ḥry-ib: ḥry-ib — middle, midst (lit. "what is upon the heart"); m ḥry-ib "in the midst of"
ḥm: ḥm — majesty (ḥm n N "the Majesty of N", of gods and kings)
·ti: ·ti — 2nd person singular ending of the stative ("you are …, you have …"; written ·tw here)
pn: pn — this (masculine demonstrative, after its noun)
ꜥšꜣ: ꜥšꜣ — many, numerous, much (the lizard sign)
ḫr-sk-šw: ḫr-sk-šw — Kher-sek-Shu, the name of the door of the hall (meaning unclear; Budge: "Driver away of Shu")
stm: stm — a part of a door — leaf or panel (reading and sense uncertain; Budge: setem, "leaf")
ḥry: ḥry — upper, who/which is above, upon (nisba of ḥr)
ẖry: ẖry — lower, who/which is beneath (nisba of ẖr)
tp: tp — head, top; ḥry tp "who is upon" (noun)
pḥty: pḥty — strength, might (nb pḥty "lord of strength")
ṯs: ṯs — to tie, knot; to raise up; to marshal, command (verb)
twk: twk — you (2nd person masculine singular independent pronoun, a later form)
ḥsb: ḥsb — to reckon, count; sš ḥsb "accounting scribe" (verb)
ḥtp-nṯr: ḥtp-nṯr — god's offerings, the offerings of a temple (noun)
imꜣḫ: imꜣḫ — honour, reverence; the honoured state of the blessed dead (nb imꜣḫ "possessor of honour")

__broaden__.n: n — not; negates the verb ('I have not …') · also the preposition "to, for" (n·i "to me") and the negative in n wn "there is not"
__broaden__.ir: ir — to do, make (lemma iri) · also the particle "when, if" (ir ꜥq·i "when I entered") and, apparently, a question particle ("do you know?")
__broaden__.pr: pr — comes forth, 'who comes forth' (participle of pri, to go/come out) · also the noun "house, temple, domain" (pr wsir "the house of Osiris"); the verb itself is filed under pri
__broaden__.ḥmt: ḥmt — a wife, married woman · plural ḥmwt "women"
__broaden__.m: m — in, from (preposition) · also "with" (instrument), "as" (m bnw "as the Bennu"), "on" (living on), "by"; im before a suffix (im·i, im·f, im·tn)
